bio: Adam Manning is a lighting programmer, board operator, and electrician based in Southern California, working across regional theatre, live music, and corporate events. Recent credits include programming and running the board at Pasadena Playhouse (*Amadeus*, *MEXODUS*, *The Visit*), South Coast Repertory, and Latino Theater Company at the Los Angeles Theatre Center.

Adam started in 2017 on the followspot and electrics crews at Tuacahn's outdoor amphitheatre in Southern Utah, moving to the board and programming seat over the following seasons. From 2021 to 2024 Adam was a lighting technician on Cirque du Soleil's *KÀ* in Las Vegas, alongside stadium and corporate work — from Raiders games at Allegiant Stadium to CrowdStrike Fal.Con Fest and the network install at the Las Vegas Grand Prix Plaza. Occasional lighting design for concerts and corporate events rounds things out.

Electrics — hang, focus, maintenance, practical builds
